job.title: Sales Development Manager
job.description:
## About the role
As a Sales Development Manager (Associate Manager level), you will lead and optimize a high-performing Upmarket outbound Sales Development team. Your primary objective is to drive consistent pipeline generation through strategic outbound efforts. This role requires a leader who balances high-level strategy with hands-on coaching to ensure the team effectively navigates complex prospecting and overcomes sophisticated objections. You will act as a bridge between your representatives and the broader sales organization, fostering a culture of professional growth and data-driven excellence.
## What you'll do
* Lead and develop a team of Outbound Sales Development Representatives through consistent accountability, personalized coaching, and ongoing skill training. * Drive monthly team performance to ensure the department consistently meets or exceeds qualified pipeline quotas and activity expectations. * Partner with Account Executives and Regional Sales Managers to refine qualification guidelines and implement process improvements that increase win rates. * Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene to ensure accurate reporting of key metrics and to identify trends that drive productive sales behaviors. * Enhance overall team productivity by implementing modern sales methodologies and maximizing the impact of the sales tech stack. * Facilitate professional development initiatives that prepare Sales Development Representatives for future advancement within the sales organization.
## What we're looking for
* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 2 years of experience in high-performing Sales Development leadership or a senior "player-coach" capacity. * Proven track record of outperforming expectations in a B2B SaaS environment, with a specific focus on driving quality meetings for Account Executives. * Deep proficiency with Salesforce, SalesLoft, and other inside sales technologies to monitor activity and maximize output. * Analytical mindset with the ability to draw actionable insights from sales data and call recordings to frame effective coaching sessions. * Strong communication skills with a focus on teaching strategic prospecting, organization, and sophisticated objection handling. * Experience collaborating with Marketing and Sales Operations to align outbound messaging with broader integrated campaigns.
## What we offer
* Employment type: Full-time * Seniority: L5 — Manager * Work mode: Hybrid

job.title: Account Executive, SMB/CMRL – Job Posting
job.description:
About the Role

Motive is seeking a driven Account Executive to help build and expand our sales organization in our newest regional market — México. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating growth, building customer relationships from the ground up, and shaping how Motive delivers value in the region.

You will leverage Motive's strong product positioning and proven global success to identify new opportunities, close business, and bring measurable impact to our customers' operations.This is an ideal role for a high-performing Sales Development Representative (SDR) or Business Development Representative (BDR) who has mastered the art of prospecting and is ready to take the next step into a full-cycle closing role.We are looking for individuals who thrive in fast-moving environments, love building markets, and want to grow within a world-class organization.

This is a hybrid position based in México City, with occasional travel required for client meetings.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle– from prospecting and pipeline generation to closing and onboarding new customers.

  • Develop new businessby building strong relationships with key prospects and stakeholders.

  • Consistently exceed sales targets, driving growth across Small & Medium Business accounts in priority verticals such as transportation, logistics, construction, and field services.

  • Collaborate with sales leadershipto localize playbooks, refine go-to-market strategies, and strengthen our commercial footprint in México.

  • Conduct needs-based discoveryand deliver compelling presentations that translate Motive's value into tangible business outcomes.

  • Negotiate and close dealswith professionalism and precision, ensuring a win-win outcome for customers and the company.

  • Work cross-functionallywith Customer Success, Sales Operations, and Marketing to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success.

  • Stay ahead of market trends, leveraging insights to enhance your consultative approach and strengthen your competitive positioning.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated success as an SDR/BDR with strong outbound and closing exposure, or 1+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales (ideally within SaaS or technology).

  • Proven ability to manage a high-velocity pipeline, maintain a rigorous daily activity cadence, and consistently exceed quota.

  • Understanding of 1–2 month sales cycleswith deal values typically in the mid-five-figure (USD) range.

  • A true hunter mentality– resourceful, resilient, and passionate about winning new logos.

  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skillsacross all organizational levels.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, high-growth settings, with strong prioritization and self-management skills.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Slack, and other modern sales tools.

  • Experience selling into transportation, logistics, oil & gas, construction, or compliance and safety industries is a strong plus.

  • Must currently reside in México and be fluent in Spanish and English.

Why Join Motive

At Motive, we're on a mission to transform the physical economy with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. You'll join a global sales team that values ownership, continuous learning, and teamwork.We are committed to being a seedbed for talent, offering a clear growth path for ambitious professionals to evolve from development roles into high-impact closing positions.If you're passionate about driving growth, building meaningful customer relationships, and shaping the future of Motive in Latin America — we'd love to meet you.

job.title: Account Executive, Mid Market – México
job.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to join our team in Mexico. In this role, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying, nurturing, and closing opportunities with mid-sized organizations. You will act as a strategic advisor to prospective clients, helping them understand how our solutions solve their specific business challenges.

This is a key position for our expansion in the region, requiring a professional who understands the local business landscape and can build lasting relationships with key decision-makers. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from initial discovery to final negotiation, ensuring a seamless transition to our customer success team.

What you'll do

  • Manage the full-cycle sales process for mid-market accounts within the Mexican territory.
  • Conduct deep discovery sessions to understand prospect pain points and map them to our product capabilities.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that highlight business value and ROI for diverse stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of opportunities through proactive outbound efforts and inbound lead management.
  • Negotiate contract terms and pricing to reach mutually beneficial agreements and meet quarterly revenue targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and product, to share market insights and improve our regional strategy.
  • Maintain accurate records of all sales activities and forecasts within our CRM platform.

What we're looking for

  • Significant experience in B2B SaaS sales, specifically targeting the mid-market segment in Mexico.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas in a high-growth environment.
  • Strong ability to navigate complex organizational structures and influence multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Native-level fluency in Spanish and professional proficiency in English.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to territory management and forecasting.
  • Self-motivated mindset with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team culture.

What we offer

  • Competitive annual salary of $70,000 MXN.
  • Opportunity to lead growth initiatives in a key regional market.
  • Professional development and clear pathways for career progression.
  • A supportive, inclusive work environment that values transparency and results.

job.title: Account Executive, Enterprise - MX
job.description:
Motive is searching for an Account Executive, Enterprise that will be instrumental in building the sales organization from the ground up in our newest regional market, Mexico. As a member of our founding team, you will lead the charge, seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning and selling the value of business outcomes achieved in partnership with Motive.

As a founding Account Executive, you aren't just looking for a seat; you are looking to build a legacy. You possess an owner mentality and an obsessive hunger to generate demand in a high-growth, startup environment. Because this is a hands-on, founding role with little-to-no SDR support, you must be a self-starter who thrives on owning the entire pipeline—from the first cold touch to the final close. You are a hard closer who relies on technical aptitude and high attention to detail to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals. In this high-energy role, we expect a #1 Mentality and a commitment to winning as a team.


Hybrid: 3x a week in office in Mexico City


What You'll Do:

  • Own the Pipeline: Act as your own SDR by prospecting and winning new business; you'll identify and engage key prospects who aren't necessarily on LinkedIn to generate consistent volume.
  • Master the Long Game: Manage complex, high-stakes sales cycles (9–12 months) with an average ACV of $100k+, effectively navigating multiple stakeholders and moving parts.
  • Drive Business Outcomes: Use sales methodologies like MEDDIC or BANT to conduct deep discovery, moving beyond features to sell true business value.
  • Scale the Market: Partner with sales leadership to build and enhance Mexico-specific playbooks, pitches, and outbound processes from scratch.
  • Navigate Resistance: Exhibit extreme resilience; you are the type of person who digs deeper when told "no" and views challenges as a path to improvement.
  • Strategic Planning: Effectively plan and execute sequences of actions to meet and exceed revenue quotas and ongoing business goals.


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of demonstrated success in full-cycle direct sales within B2B environments.
  • The Definition of Drive: You embody the disciplined "ride-or-die" pursuit of a legacy, fueled by an obsessive hunger for opportunity and the grit to turn every "no" into progress.
  • Complex Product Experience: Proven track record selling complex, technical solutions (e.g., IoT, Data, Cybersecurity, Payroll, or SaaS) with annual revenue per deal in the six-figure range.
  • Entrepreneurial "Hunter" Mentality: You define yourself by your ranking among the best and have a history of overachievement in fully outbound environments.
  • Methodology Mastery: Deep experience in value-based selling using MEDDIC, BANT, or Sandler to navigate enterprise-level friction.
  • Resilience & Grit: A "why" that goes beyond material gain; you are disciplined, resilient, and constantly seeking to improve your craft.
  • Market Knowledge: Experience selling into trucking, oil & gas, construction, transportation, logistics, or safety is a significant plus.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert-level understanding of Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, and Slack.


What's In It For You?

While the expectations are high, the rewards for being a founding member of our Mexico team are unparalleled. We aren't just offering a job; we're offering the chance to own a market.

  • Be a Founding Architect: You aren't just following a playbook; you're writing it. As one of the first boots on the ground in Mexico, your insights will directly shape our regional strategy, culture, and operational DNA.
  • Uncapped Career Trajectory: Success in this role doesn't just lead to a promotion—it builds your legacy. Founding AEs are naturally positioned for future leadership roles as we scale the regional team from one to dozens.
  • Prestige & Visibility: This is a high-stakes expansion for Motive. You will have direct exposure to executive leadership and the chance to represent the brand in a critical new territory.
  • High-Impact Earnings: We reward "hunters" who deliver. With an average ACV of $100k+, your success in navigating complex deals translates into significant financial upside and a competitive compensation package.
  • Solve Real-World Problems: You'll be selling a product that literally keeps the world moving. Our technology improves safety and efficiency in essential industries like logistics, construction, and energy—sectors that drive the Mexican economy.
  • A "Masterclass" in Entrepreneurship: If you have aspirations to eventually run your own company or lead a global sales org, there is no better training ground than building a multi-million dollar pipeline from scratch with the backing of a global unicorn.
